name: Man's Last Friends
source:
Emilio is a Dachshund on his way to his very first day at doggy daycare! There he'll meet new friends, eat new treats, and learn new things! Though...maybe there are things he wishes he didn't learn about... 

[From [url=https://wublingk.itch.io/mans-last-friends]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
埃米利奥是一只腊肠犬，正在前往狗狗日托中心的第一天！在那里他会结识新朋友，吃新美食，学习新事物！不过……也许有些事情他希望自己不知道…… 

[来自[url=https://wublingk.itch.io/mans-last-friends]itch.io[/url]]
